data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Survicate mobile surveys
data.what_it_does: Provides an API to initialize the Survicate SDK, trigger events, track screens, set user traits, and listen to survey lifecycle events in a Flutter app.
use_when: You need to collect user feedback via Survicate surveys
You already have a Survicate account and want to integrate surveys into a Flutter app
You want to track events and user traits for targeted surveys
avoid_when: You don't have a Survicate account
You need a custom survey UI not provided by Survicate
strengths: Easy to set up with a single dependency
Supports Android and iOS out of the box
Offers event listeners for survey lifecycle
Allows setting user traits and locale
weaknesses: Requires native configuration steps (AndroidManifest, Info.plist, Maven repo, CocoaPods)
No built‑in UI components for surveys (relies on Survicate native UI)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, configure AndroidManifest.xml with workspace key, add Survicate Maven repo, configure iOS Info.plist, run pod update, call SurvicateSdk.initializeSdk() in main app widget
